_format.level: feature(蓝框,新功能) | promo(绿框,免费模型活动) | info(默认) | warning(行为变更) | critical(紧急)

_format.titleEn/bodyEn: 可选英文；英文界面优先显示，缺省回退主字段
_format.link: 可选，显示「了解更多」按钮

items.title: Trae 拆线：国内 / 国际两条供应商 + 每日签到
items.body: 账号本就不互通，现在拆成两张卡，登录不再选站点；老连接零迁移。新增每日签到领积分与额度查询（套餐名 + 权益包明细），纯文本对话改走轻量直连通道。
items.titleEn: Trae split into CN / Intl providers + daily check-in
items.bodyEn: Two account pools that never talked are now two provider cards — no site picker, existing connections unchanged. Daily credit check-in and quota card (plan + packs) added; plain chat now uses the lightweight direct channel.

items.title: Meoo（秒悟）接入：阿里系新免费池
items.body: 官方 OAuth 或直接粘贴 Key 两种接入方式；模型目录实时同步网关；用量卡显示积分余额，每日登录可领积分。
items.titleEn: Meoo added: a new free pool from Alibaba Cloud
items.bodyEn: Official OAuth or paste-a-key onboarding; the model catalog mirrors the live gateway; the quota card shows your points balance with a daily login claim.

items.title: Loomy 每日赠送积分优先：单账号烧穿调度
items.body: 多账号时锁定一个号把当日 5000 赠送积分烧完才换号，绝不平摊；烧尽自动关闭、次日 0 点自动重开。开关在 Loomy 供应商页，默认关闭。
items.titleEn: Loomy daily grant first: single-account burn scheduling
items.bodyEn: Traffic sticks to one account until its 5000 daily points are fully burned, never spread thin; drained accounts auto-close and reopen at midnight. Toggle on the Loomy provider page, off by default.

items.title: 修复：只有思考没有正文的回复不再被客户端丢弃
items.body: 流式结束前自动把思考提升为正文；组合模式判定零可用内容时自动顺延下一模型。Hermes Agent 等严格客户端受益。
items.titleEn: Fixed: reasoning-only responses no longer dropped
items.bodyEn: Thinking content is promoted to the reply body before the stream ends; combo mode advances to the next model on zero usable content. Strict clients like Hermes Agent benefit.

items.title: 新功能：隐私脱敏——让上游看不到你的密钥
items.body: 连接详情里打开「隐私脱敏」，出站请求里的 API Key、私钥、JWT 会被替换成占位符，模型回显的内容自动还原成原文。默认关闭，只对你不信任的上游开启。
items.titleEn: New: privacy redaction — keep your keys away from upstreams
items.bodyEn: Turn on “Privacy redaction” in a connection and API keys, private keys and JWTs in the outbound request become placeholders; anything the model echoes back is restored before it reaches you. Off by default — enable it only for upstreams you do not trust.

items.title: 讯飞 Loomy 免费池：8 个免费模型 + 手机验证码直登
items.body: 内置 Spark X2.6、Qwen 3.8、DeepSeek V4.1、MiniMax M3、Kimi K2.6、GLM 5.3 Flash 等 8 个模型。供应商页点「验证码登录」，输手机号收码即可，无需安装客户端，会话 14 天有效。
items.titleEn: iFlytek Loomy free pool: 8 free models + phone-code sign-in
items.bodyEn: Eight models built in — Spark X2.6, Qwen 3.8, DeepSeek V4.1, MiniMax M3, Kimi K2.6, GLM 5.3 Flash and more. On the provider page press “SMS Login”, enter your phone number, done — no client install needed, session lasts about 14 days.

items.title: 代理行为变更：不可直连渠道默认严格模式
items.body: Google Cloud Code、Gemini CLI 等渠道代理失败立即报错并顺位接力，不再回退直连死等（此前实测 788s）。连接级显式 strictProxy 优先。
items.titleEn: Proxy behavior change: direct-connect channels now default to strict mode
items.bodyEn: For channels that cannot connect directly (Google Cloud Code, Gemini CLI, …), a proxy failure now errors immediately and relays to the next account/combo member instead of hanging on a blocked direct connection (788s observed). Connection-level strictProxy overrides the default.

items.title: 新增 Inception Labs（Mercury 扩散模型）
items.body: OpenAI 兼容。mercury-3：1M ctx / 工具调用 / ~1000 tok/s，launch 半价 $0.10/$0.35，新 key 送 1 亿 tokens（额度经 CreditDaddy 通用卡推送）。
items.titleEn: New provider: Inception Labs (Mercury diffusion models)
items.bodyEn: OpenAI compatible. mercury-3: 1M ctx / tool calling / ~1000 tok/s, 50% off launch at $0.10/$0.35; new keys include 100M free tokens (quota via the CreditDaddy generic card).

items.title: 组合新增 router 策略
items.body: 固定顺序/轮询不看谁更擅长当前任务；Router 由决策模型分析用户 prompt，动态挑最擅长的成员回答——仅一次额外调用，兼顾能力与速度；失败/超时 8s 内自动退回原顺序。
items.bodyEn: Order/round-robin ignores model strengths. Router analyzes your prompt and picks the best-suited member to answer — one extra call; failures/timeouts fall back to the original order within 8s.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 正式收录
items.body: Gemini 4 Argon 全线接入（gemini / vertex / antigravity 官方三线），支持常开推理与 1M 上下文；Codex 接入 GPT-6.1 Sol，采用全新极速 Responses Lite 协议传输。
items.titleEn: Gemini 4 Argon & GPT-6.1 Sol official support
items.bodyEn: Full Gemini 4 Argon support across gemini, vertex, and antigravity with always-on reasoning and 1M context; Codex adds GPT-6.1 Sol over the new Responses Lite transport protocol.
